criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

Attribute operators read via the adapter's attribute-value method and return false when the attribute value is null (absent), for all operators except negation. Cited evidence must show per-operator null handling.
The `!=` (not-equal) operator treats a missing attribute as a match (missing is 'not equal'), and with an empty value matches only present, non-empty attributes.
The `^=`, `$=`, `*=` operators never match when the value is empty, and `~=` never matches when its value contains whitespace (early always-false path).

criteria.text: The `|=` operator matches only on exact equality or the value followed immediately by a hyphen, not any arbitrary prefix.
The `~=` operator matches the value as a whitespace-separated token via word-boundary logic rather than plain substring.
Case-insensitive attribute matching is applied (lowercasing both sides or case-insensitive regex) and is gated by a helper considering explicit flags plus xml/quirks mode.
Context 'has parents' detection treats context as document-level only if every element is the internal placeholder OR a tag with a non-null parent, correctly gating descendant absolutization.
The relative-selector-disabled guard inspects only the first token of each branch and throws only when it is a traversal, not eagerly on normal selectors.
